trials.caps: 90 steps / 90 min for the outline and for each hole, then 2 fix rounds of 20 / 20; up to 2 tries per task
trials.summary: The model first writes an outline of the proof in which every step it has not proved is a sorry hole. Each hole then becomes a task of its own, after a quick pass of standard tactics, a ledger keeps every hole Lean has checked, and an assembly puts the pieces together. 2 of 3 leaves proved. F01, an open leaf that trials 3 and 4 had failed, was proved and accepted by prove2me: its first outline left the main claim in two holes, which failed twice; a second outline split the index into four fields, as the leaf’s own statement does, and all 6 of its holes were proved and assembled on the first try. Calibration leaf C12 was proved on the second try of its assembly. We stopped O02, which is not scored.

trials.caps: one round of 110 steps / 110 min for the outline and for each hole, then one fix round of 20 / 20; up to 2 tries per task
trials.summary: The outline task now starts with a plan, every step of it becomes a sorry hole (at most 12 holes and 300 lines), and an outline that does not compile is repaired by turning the parts Lean rejects into holes. All 3 leaves were closed. Open leaf p2m-dbd69f was proved by the model and accepted by prove2me: its first outline had a false hole, which the model disproved; its second outline, the paper's duality argument in four steps, had every hole proved and was assembled. Open leaf p2m-f181df was closed by reuse of a theorem already proved on prove2me, and calibration leaf p2m-3ad60f was proved by assembly.

trials.caps: one round of 110 steps / 110 min for the outline and for each hole, then one fix round of 20 / 20; up to 2 tries per task
trials.summary: Scaffold v8: v7 with what trial 6 taught. A counterexample to a false hole goes into the next outline's prompt, and an outline that proves the leaf ends it. 3 of 4 leaves were proved, and prove2me accepted both open leaves among them. Open leaf p2m-aec6a2 was proved from its first outline: its two holes were closed and the proof assembled. Open leaf p2m-d00cfc took three outlines: standard tactics closed every hole of the first two, which the outline check then refused as having no real step (since changed: such an outline is a proof); the third had 2 holes, both proved, and was assembled. Calibration leaf p2m-3ad60f was proved again, through an outline with one hole. Open leaf p2m-115f6c (Pinsker's inequality, the hard one) was not proved: of its three outlines, with 8, 3 and 9 holes, most holes were proved, but in each some hole failed both tries or was shown to be false.
